verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 6 remains correct, sound, and complete. The shared generated_at grammar gates both whole-plan validation and the service-order helper before even empty or singleton queues can short-circuit. Dispatch validates the plan before mutation, then obtains each repository's review work only through review_service_queue(plan, repo); that helper exact-matches the repository partition, applies a deterministic pure rotation, and preserves every admitted row without crossing policy boundaries. The probabilistic fairness claim is appropriately qualified and does not promise a deadline. Tests independently pin malformed-input refusal, exact offsets, rotation shape, totality, reproducibility, caller non-mutation, repository isolation, the live dispatch call and both arguments, and non-vacuity against representative permissive call-site mutations. I found no correctness, trust-boundary, security, or test-validity issue. Round 5 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required rubric while approval remains warranted.
